:::{#def-power}
#### Power

The **power** of a test of a null hypothesis $H_0$ about a parameter $\param$,
against an alternative value $\param_1$,
is the probability that the test rejects $H_0$
when $\param$ equals $\param_1$:

$$\text{power}(\param_1) \eqdef \Prf{\text{reject } H_0 \mid \param = \param_1}.$$
:::
